mechanism_attribution: FACT, not inference: the GitHub annotations API records exit code 78 and the wrapper's own LEX_WORK_QUANTUM_EXPIRED / quantum-ended-cleanly lines for this job. Only the exact step boundary (2704 s vs the 2700 s constant) is derived arithmetic.
consequence: the wrapper exited 78, so 'Validate active MVP producer state' and 'Enforce lane write scope' were SKIPPED and audit/integrate were gated off (needs.team.result != success). Persist team snapshot still ran, so the producer's committed work is intact on the snapshot ref.
control_plane_note: .github/** is control-plane scope and is recorded, never edited from this lane. Recorded hardening item for the control-plane maintainer: a producer that has already committed its deliverable still fails the chain on quantum expiry, so the post-steps that make a snapshot audit-ready are lost even when the work is not. Route-around used here: front-load durable commits and re-execute the skipped gates in the resume cycle.
